title: Homeowner Tier Credit on the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Visit Fee
content:
**Member terms.** A tier credit is taken off the rider visit fee of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider service request according to the tier of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract:

| Base homeowner contract tier | Tier credit |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | USD 25.00 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | USD 10.00 |
| Any other tier | None |

**Hypothetical cases.** A rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum contract: USD 25.00 comes off the rider visit fee. A rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Silver contract: no tier credit.
